data.title: Ethereum leads stablecoins with 54.1% share; it... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum remains the dominant blockchain for stablecoins, accounting for about 54.1% of all stablecoins issued, totaling around $162.5 billion out of a $300 billion market. Its tokenized stock market has grown 170% year-over-year to approximately $827 million, though it still represents a small fraction compared to stablecoins. While Ethereum leads in stablecoin issuance, BNB Chain leads in tokenized equities, with the overall tokenized stock market surpassing $3 billion. Investors are watching whether tokenized stocks might follow the growth trajectory of stablecoins in the coming years.
data.author: Crypto Briefing
